test_title: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 06 Jun, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Refer to the following number and symbol series and answer the question that follows.

 Counting to be done from left to right only. All numbers are single-digit numbers.

 (Left) 4 @ 7 4 £ 9 9 # @ 1 4 $ % 4 3 8 2 © © 1 5 # (Right)

 How many such numbers are there each of which is immediately preceded by a number

 and also immediately followed by a number?
solution:
Given series: (Left) 4 @ 7 4 £ 9 9 # @ 1 4 $ % 4 3 8 2 © © 1 5 # (Right)

According to the question such numbers are there which are immediately preceded by a number and also immediately followed by a number:

Required condition: Number - Number - Number

(Left) 4 @ 7 4 £ 9 9 # @ 1 4 $ % __**4 3 8 2**__ © © 1 5 # (Right)

Thus, there are two such numbers are there which are immediately preceded by a number and also immediately followed by a number.

Hence, "Option 3" is the correct answer.
